title: Subtraction exit labels
statement: For natural-number parameters $a,b,f$, define the exit label at the site past the unary block to be the first-letter separator in the walk, the exit label at the site past the doubled adjacency word to be tail position $0$, and the exit label at the site that leaves the target coordinate to be the dispatch test for whether the source coordinate is zero.
